native.boundary: Saved target-process mapping inventories are linked to rehashed current bytes. No live-process maps or GPU execution is recreated by this CPU review.

benchmark_native.boundary: All libraries mapped before the independent raw matrix benchmark match the replay's final inventory and retain identical recorded file identities afterward.
